app_fee.value: No tuition or application fees are charged for pursuing a doctorate at KIT.
app_fee.quote: When pursuing a doctorate at KIT, no tuition fees will be charged

fee_waiver.value: Doctoral studies at KIT carry no tuition or application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: When pursuing a doctorate at KIT, no tuition fees will be charged

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required; admission is decided by the department Doctoral Admissions Committee.
gre_general.quote: For your ▶ acceptance as doctoral researcher by the KIT department, your degree will also be checked by the Doctoral Admissions Committee.

toefl_min.value: Doctoral candidates are expected to have a good command of English, but formal test certificates like TOEFL are not usually required centrally.
toefl_min.quote: As a rule, doctoral candidates are expected to have a very good command of English, even if formal proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is not usually required

ielts_min.value: Doctoral candidates are expected to have a good command of English, but formal test certificates like IELTS are not usually required centrally.
ielts_min.quote: As a rule, doctoral candidates are expected to have a very good command of English, even if formal proof such as TOEFL or IELTS is not usually required

english_waiver.value: The KHYS pages do not mention India or English-medium degrees; the language requirement is set with the supervisor.
english_waiver.quote: Please note that you must clarify the language requirements for the doctorate with your supervisor

notes: Umbrella rules from KHYS: admission is by each KIT department under its doctoral regulations. Department pages checked: Physics, Mathematics, Informatics, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering/Geo and Environmental Sciences, Chemical and Process Engineering. Not usable: Chemistry and Biosciences PhD page (application form only), ETIT doctoral page (no admission rules).
